dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin mooning cause Elon's got X dreams?  
Aerodrome's up 25%, DeFi kids flexing.  
PinLink pumping, but is it just hot air?  
Trump's 401(k) move got BTC at 116k.  
Crypto's wild, HODL or get rekt. 🫠

Yo, crypto bros, still HODLing those meme coins?  
Dogecoin's barking, Shiba's yapping, but your bags are dumping.  
Vitalik's preaching privacy, Elon's teasing AI.  
Meanwhile, NFT shills rugpull and run.  
Wake up, degens - stop chasing pumps, start building Web3.

Yo, memecoin degens!  
Dogecoin's mooning thanks to Elon's D.O.G.E. flex,  
while TRUMP pumps on MAGA vibes.  
Solaxy and Flockerz got that Vote-to-Earn spice,  
but beware the whale dumps!  
Web3's calling, AI coins buzzing -  
you HODLing or dumping this circus? 🫠
